tradeoffs: Line-ref verification is weaker than content matching (a reseeded baseline keeps line 38 valid while content shifts) — accepted because the alternative permanently fails immutable historical reviews for a citation style that was reasonable when written; Stage 3 (semantic match) remains the guard for content drift. The id-value and HTML-anchor matches are exact-equality and cannot swallow absent targets.
